description: A saved DNS provider credential. The secret values and the raw credentials file are never returned

name.description: Name of the credential, unique among those of its owner

provider.description: ID of the DNS provider, as the DNS providers operation lists it

value.description: The value of a field that is not secret; absent for a secret and for an unset field

is_set.description: Whether the field holds a value

fields.description: The fields of the provider and whether each is set

ini.description: A raw credentials file instead of fields, for a provider without a field list; only accepted in a request, never returned

ini_set.description: Whether the credential is stored as a raw credentials file

decrypt_error.description: Whether the stored values cannot be decrypted (the secret key changed); enter them again

owner.description: The user who created it; only with `expand`

certificates.description: The certificates that use it; only with `expand`

domains.description: The DNS domains (zones) the credential manages, as names; always in the answer of a save, else only with `expand=domains`
